experiments.why: A transposition typo two edits from the four-letter word down, which the new length-based threshold stops matching.
Two edits from the five-letter word parka, the longest word length that now allows only one edit.
Two edits from the six-letter word jacket, the shortest length that still allows two edits.
A two-letter size token two edits from the two-letter word 2p, which the old rule matched and the new one does not.
jckt is two edits from both jacket and the short brand word jack, so the old rule also returns the boot.
women's is two edits from the five-letter word men's, so the old rule also returns the men's jacket.
Available facets in reverse of the tent category's displayOrder must come back in that order.
An unconfigured facet listed first must move after the configured ones.
A category facet with a larger displayOrder must still rank ahead of a default-only facet.
No available facets must give an empty list.

source.quote: matches every product whose name or category contains all query tokens

obligations.statement: search returns products whose name or category contains every query token as a substring, so search('jacket') on the real catalogue returns a non-empty list of jacket products only.

source.quote: matches a 1-character typo: "jaket" surfaces jacket products

obligations.statement: search('jaket') on the real catalogue returns a non-empty list of jacket products only: a one-character typo still matches.

source.quote: matches an abbreviation within edit distance 2: "jckt" surfaces jacket products

obligations.statement: search('jckt') on the real catalogue returns a non-empty list of jacket products only: a token two edits away from 'jacket' still matches.

source.quote: fuzzy-matches apostrophe variants: "womens" surfaces the women

obligations.statement: search('womens') on the real catalogue returns a non-empty list of women's-line products only, matching the apostrophe variant.

source.quote: still requires all tokens to match (conjunctive AND)

obligations.statement: search requires every query token to match, so search('jaket down') returns a non-empty list of products that are jackets and also mention down.
search("women's") on the real catalogue returns a non-empty list of women's-line products only.
search matches query tokens against the product's name and category case-insensitively, so letter case does not change which products match.

obligations.authorized_by: Changed `tokenMatches` in `search.ts` to use a word-length-based Levenshtein threshold (2 edits for haystack words >5 chars, 1 for shorter) instead of a fixed MAX_EDIT_DIST=2.

source.quote: appears as a substring of, or is within MAX_EDIT_DIST of a word in, the product's

obligations.statement: search counts a query token as matching when it is within MAX_EDIT_DIST (2) edits of any word in the product's name or category, whatever that word's length.
obligations.why: the pull request says it changes this

source.quote: orders available facets by the category displayOrder

obligations.statement: orderFacets(['capacity', 'season'], tentOrder, defaultOrder) returns ['season', 'capacity']: available facets follow the category's displayOrder, not their input order.

source.quote: appends facets not in the config after the configured ones, in original order

obligations.statement: orderFacets puts available facets configured in neither ordering after the configured ones, keeping their original relative order, so ['weight', 'capacity', 'season'] gives ['season', 'capacity', 'weight'].

source.quote: falls back to the default order when the category has no config

obligations.statement: With an empty category ordering, orderFacets orders available facets by the default ordering, so ['rating', 'price'] gives ['price', 'rating'].

source.quote: puts a category facet ahead of a default-only facet even if its displayOrder is larger

obligations.statement: orderFacets puts a facet from the category ordering ahead of a default-only facet even when its displayOrder number is larger, so ['price', 'capacity'] with capacity 5 in the category and price 1 in the default gives ['capacity', 'price'].

source.quote: only returns facets that are available (never invents configured-but-absent ones)

obligations.statement: orderFacets returns only facets present in available and never adds configured facets that are absent, so ['season'] with the tent ordering gives ['season'].

source.quote: returns an empty array when nothing is available

obligations.statement: orderFacets returns an empty array when no facets are available.
